commit f89d7b0bdafe6c0ec6a629dea9a8babd0cd39203
Author: alexander-abramovich <alexander.abramovich.18@gmail.com>
Date:   Thu Aug 13 23:08:13 2026 +0300

    Three copies of the table-row split agree with each other on an escaped pipe
    
    tests/test_traceability.py's _roadmap_body_rows and TestQueue._rows, and
    scripts/rotate-doc.py's _status_cell, all split a ROADMAP row on every raw
    `|`, naive and backslash-blind. guardrails/check-landing-next-steps.py
    already carries the fix (CELL_SPLIT_RE = re.compile(r"(?<!\\)\|") at line
    64, used at line 92); this mirrors that idiom into the other two, adding
    one module-level regex + a _split_row_cells helper to test_traceability.py
    (both call sites rewired) and inlining the same regex into rotate-doc.py's
    _status_cell, its one call site.
    
    Red-first proof: both new fixtures were added and run before the
    production change landed —
    tests/test_traceability.py::TestQueue::test_escaped_pipe_cell_parses_as_five_cells
    failed with NameError: name '_split_row_cells' is not defined, and
    tests/test_doc_rotation.py::TestMechanism::test_rotate_reads_status_past_an_escaped_pipe_in_the_wish_cell
    failed with "rotate-doc: HALT — row 14 is not fully closed (status:
    'small')" — the Status cell shifted left by the phantom column the
    unescaped `\|` created. After the production change, both pass (1 passed
    each).
    
    Expected side effect, left deliberately red, not silenced: applying the
    parser fix flips
    tests/test_traceability.py::TestQueue::test_roadmap_in_work_cap from a
    false green to a TRUE RED. Row 617 (one escaped pipe) was previously
    silently dropped by the 5-cell guard under the naive split; it now parses
    correctly and joins in_work as a fourth row alongside 568, 570, 576 —
    4 against the stated cap of 3 (SPEC T-18). This is not a regression this
    commit introduces — it is the parser fix correctly surfacing a real,
    pre-existing lane-cap overflow the bug was hiding. Which row stands down,
    or whether the cap itself moves, is an owner decision (row 616/617's own
    territory) and is left untouched here.
    
    Full-suite counts after this commit: tests/test_traceability.py — 179
    passed, 1 failed (test_roadmap_in_work_cap, expected).
    tests/test_doc_rotation.py — 34 passed.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
